description.value: Cocobay is a bubble tea café on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver specializing in bubble tea and vegetarian-friendly drinks. Located at street level in a busy urban corridor, it offers air-conditioned indoor seating — a welcome refuge on a hot ride. The downtown location puts it within easy reach of the Vancouver Seawall and other popular cycling routes.
